value.rationale: Pitchfork (three-leaf clade) count measures a basic local topology pattern, while external branch length controls singleton genealogical exposure and mutation statistics. Their dependence is a natural gap between otherwise well-studied marginal theories. The exact n=4 positive versus n>=5 negative reversal and the sign crossover across coalescent stages are structural rather than routine numerical gains, and offer a neutral-model benchmark.
